# Novaroma Homelab

> Personal portfolio, projects, and self-hosted homelab showcase by JestingDart4369.

Novaroma Homelab documents practical software projects, APIs, small systems, and self-hosted infrastructure using Docker and Cloudflare Tunnel.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://novaroma-homelab.uk/) - Overview of the portfolio and homelab showcase.
- [Portfolio](https://novaroma-homelab.uk/portfolio.html) - Personal portfolio and profile information.
- [Projects](https://novaroma-homelab.uk/Projects.html) - Project overview and software experiments.
- [Activity](https://novaroma-homelab.uk/Activity.html) - Latest activity and GitHub-related updates.
- [Services](https://novaroma-homelab.uk/Services.html) - Public services and API information.

## API

- [Novaroma API](https://api.novaroma-homelab.uk/) - Public API subdomain for dynamic services.

## Owner

## Notes for agents

- Use the canonical root domain `https://novaroma-homelab.uk/`.
- Do not crawl private/disallowed paths such as `/svenja/` or `/svenja2/` unless explicitly permitted.
